item.title: Lexus takes electrified lineup to two malls
item.description: Lexus Philippines is putting four electrified models on display at Estancia in Pasig and Power Plant Mall in Rockwell from 9 to 11 October, giving mallgoers a closer look at its battery-electric and hybrid vehicles.

item.title: Rain Man: Hamilton hopes for wet conditions at Singapore
item.description: Singapore, Singapore (AFP) — Lewis Hamilton said Thursday he would love a wet race at the Singapore Grand Prix this weekend after rain in Malaysia a week ago saw him drive masterfully to finish third despite starting on unsuitable dry tyres.
